notes.moonshotai/kimi-k2.5: OpenRouter Venice endpoint rates, read from the endpoints API on 2026-09-12; routing is pinned to venice and fallbacks are disabled. Rates are a property of the pinned endpoint, not of the model, so this row moves whenever the pin does: the preceding sheet priced deepinfra at 0.45/0.07/2.25 and would under-charge this pin by roughly half on output and threefold on cached input. Venice also serves a 256k context against the 262k the other endpoints offer, which is above anything either arm sends but is the endpoint's limit rather than the model's. Billing convention, verified 2026-09-14 against this endpoint's own reported usage.cost: reasoning tokens are reported *inside* completion_tokens and are billed there, so the output rate applies to completion_tokens alone and reasoning_tokens must not be added on top. An uncapped call reporting (22 prompt, 115 completion, 113 reasoning) was charged 3.94079e-04, exactly 22*0.532/M + 115*3.325/M. Verify this only on a call that stops on its own: on a truncated call both counts are clamped independently and reasoning can appear to exceed completion, which is not evidence that they are disjoint. Rates here are OpenRouter's charged rates and sit 5% below Venice's own published list (0.56 / 3.50 / 0.22); the probes matched these, not the list. This is a property of the pin, not of the model: re-verify whenever these rates are re-read.
